      "level": "read",
      "observed": "Every production item of the U1 contract is present. (1) classifyReplay now sends the proved goal tree that is not main to its own detached worktree, calls repeatBeforeOwn, removes the worktree and returns. If the worktree cannot be made, the commit is still attributed to its own goal and the reason gains 'the merge's tests could not be repeated alone'. With no test name that can be selected, nothing runs and attribution is as before. (2) Each top-level test name of a failed unit is one identity, and its subtests stay with it. (3) repeatRed takes a mode (batch, main or own). In own mode: attempts are named ATTEMPT-own-N, rows carry Repeat 'own', an own row of the same attempt and tree is retained, the one-repeat-per-tree guard applies to batch mode only, main retention skips own rows, no proof stop is recorded, and the completed row is appended without publishing flakes. (4) A test counts as passed alone only when the run's error is nil (a complete report with no failures and a cleanly closed log) and pass evidence is found in its log; it is saved as RepeatPassed. (5) attributeOwn receives the failures with the passed tests removed, and Cause.PassedAlone is filled. (6) red.go:71 skips own rows. (7) cause.go has both passed-alone sentence forms."
